answer: Sybil resistance can borrow from deterministic failure containment by requiring each agent identity to post a bonded stake in a shared vault, so spawning fake identities imports real capital cost rather than a free gale of registrations. A periodic challenge protocol then samples agents like fatigue inspections across a lagoon of activity, cross-checking attestations. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
